quest.title: Stories of the Past
quest.description: Go to Palais Mermonia, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Neuvillette...

talks.objective: Go to the vicinity of the Palais Mermonia to begin the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Many thanks for the invitation, Miss Guillotin. I presume this pure water was prepared specially for me?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Think nothing of it, Monsieur Neuvillette. It's an honor to have the Iudex of Fontaine take time out of his busy schedule to join me for a cup of... water.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Does the Fatui have some official business that you wish to discuss?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Not at all. This is a strictly personal visit. And there's no need to be so formal. I simply wanted to ask you about an old acquaintance.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: An old acquaintance... Ah, you must be talking about Mr. Alain Guillotin? The great Lord-Artificer.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Exactly. What kind of person was he? I heard he was your subordinate in his youth.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Mr. Guillotin was an earnest and grounded young man. Even after being granted the title of White Cavalier of Protection, he never exhibited one iota of arrogance.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: He spent most of his time studying machines. The world outside his own little bubble was of little interest to him.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Huh... So he was like that even when he was younger? I wonder if he was wise beyond his years or simply ignorant of the ways of the world.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: However... He changed dramatically after losing his family and friends.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: The Tower of Gestalt? And Elynas...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Indeed. When he and I signed the order to search the tower, he appeared... helpless.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: It was the estrangement and alienation of the past that led to all that. He must have felt guilty, too.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Hmm... He became even more taciturn after that, and our interactions grew less frequent.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: At the ceremony where he was given the title of Lord-Artificer, all he said was the following:

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: "A quiet, humble life is a surer path to happiness than the blind pursuit of endless perfection."

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Heh... And that's exactly how he lived in his later years.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I guess he wasn't just saying that to the crowd. He was saying it to himself.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: And what do you think about it all, Miss Guillotin?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Me? Hmph. I won't pass judgment on his epiphany or his way of life, just as he never told me how I should live my own.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: But I have no intention of either following his path or of imitating his ideals. I'm my own person.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Heh... Thank you. You've helped me understand him better.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: You're very welcome. It's a pleasure to share stories of the past with one of his family.

talks.objective: Go to the vicinity of the Palais Mermonia to begin the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: And a pleasure to share stories of the past with you, Miss Guillotin, over this wonderful glass of water.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Very well. Wherever you're going next, I wish you a smooth journey.
